name: James R. Browning U.S. Court of Appeals Building (9th Circuit)
note: 1905 Beaux-Arts courthouse (James Knox Taylor) + 1933-34 Kelham addition, a whole city block. No usable Mapillary frame (way/38612651 junk); confirmed by name (Wikipedia, GSA, Library of Congress): white Sierra granite, rusticated base, rows of arched windows, enclosed pediments, balustrades — no free-standing colonnade. TWO OSM ways cover ONE building (the relation is the whole-block multipolygon, way/38612651 its inner courtyard core); modelled as one entry over the union rather than two bodies, since the street reads it as a single monumental block.
